h1: Limit increase: from request to the new account limit
sub: Five actors and six phases. The credit engine decides 71% of requests on its own; the analyst intervenes only when the amount exceeds the maximum limit or the score is in the gray zone.

elements.text: Enter the requested amount and current income, then confirm
Validate the session, check open requests and send to the engine
Calculate the score (12 months) and policy maximum limit
Notify the decline and next request date (90 days)
Review, request proof if needed and decide the amount
Apply the new account limit and record the audit trail
Notify the customer of the approved limit
View the new limit on the account screen

sections.title: Credit engine decision
items: Amount within the maximum limit and score above the threshold. Sent to operations; notification in about 3 minutes.
Amount above the maximum limit or score in the gray zone. Approves, approves a lower amount or declines; notification in about 9 hours.
Score below the threshold. The customer receives the reason and can request again in 90 days.

sections.title: Who receives the result
items: The new limit, or the reason for declining and the next request date.
Each case outcome feeds back into policy calibration.
The request history to answer questions.

band.f1: 42,000 requests per month; the engine decides 71% without an analyst, notifying in 3 minutes versus 9 hours with analyst involvement.
band.f2: Requesting proof of income through the app is part of the review and is not shown as a separate step.
